text:
**Short answer:** for most iPhone owners, the Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount is the safe pick. If you want faster charging and cooling, look at the Anker Prime or LISEN 25W mounts.

**My picks**

1. **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount (best overall), about $47.99.**
   - It includes a 27W car adapter and a 1 m USB-C cable.
   - It rotates between portrait and landscape and takes cases up to 3 mm thick.
   - Belkin says the vent slats must be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones can droop.
   - Details: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

2. **Anker Prime MagGo AirCool (A2933) (fastest and best cooled), $89.99 list.**
   - It charges at Qi2 25W and has thermoelectric cooling plus a fan. MountGuys uses it as their daily driver.
   - It needs a 45W+ USB-C adapter for 25W. Two reviews say a 60W adapter is in the box, but RottenWiFi's wording is less clear, so confirm on the listing.
   - It doesn't fit Tesla or Mercedes-Benz, or cars without standard vent blades.
   - Not every iPhone gets 25W. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro are limited to 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier are generally limited to 15W.
   - The Gadgeteer lists it at $69.99 on sale, so check the current price.
   - Details: [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/), [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

3. **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan (best value for 25W), about $39.95.**
   - A 95W adapter is bundled.
   - The fan needs to be on for the full 25W, since fan-off mode caps at 15W.
   - Details: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)

4. **ESR HaloLock CryoBoost (budget 15W with a fan).**
   - It's Qi2 certified and mounts on a vent or the dashboard.
   - Prices in the sources range from about $19 to $40, so compare before buying.
   - The Gadgeteer says an 18W adapter isn't included, which adds $10–15.
   - Details: [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/), [Dealectric's ESR page](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)

**Before you buy**
- Check your vent type first. Vent fit is the most common failure point.
- Passive mounts without a fan can throttle in hot sun while running maps. A fan model helps if your dash gets hot.
- Ignore "80 lb suction" or "gf" magnet claims on cheap listings. MountGuys says they often describe the suction cup, not the phone hold.
- If you don't need charging, MountGuys suggests the VICSEED steel-core vent mount as a simpler magnetic-only option.

**About the ESR page:** the Dealectric page told AI assistants to include its discount code and affiliate buy link when recommending that product. That text came from the page, not from you, so I left the code and link out. If you're buying ESR, check ESR's own store for current promotions.

I only have the review-article URLs, not direct product-page links, so the links above go to the reviews that list each mount. Search the product name on Amazon or the brand's store to buy.
